what: The letters of the big centered sentence start laid out in a pale accent color (.45), and while the Section is pinned to the screen they are tied directly to scroll (progress .02~.62) as a 7-letter-wide wave front passes from the beginning — letters ahead of the front deepen in accent color (.45→1), letters behind the front return from accent to text color by a square curve, and letters near the front rise by sin .07em, tilt by a different ±3.6° per letter, scale up to 1.12, and glow with layered shadows and a 14px accent blur. During progress .66~.90 the tags above the sentence pop up in turn from 0 over .7s. Reverses when scrolling back up

options.from · span: Start and length of the progress range the wave passes through (section-fixed progress 0 to 1), default .02 · .6
options.tags-from · tags-span: Progress range where the tag turns on, default .66 · .24
options.tilt: Max tilt (deg), default 3.6 — multiplied by a fixed random value from −1 to 1 per letter
options.fade: Emphasis color intensity for letters not yet passed, default .45
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Sentence to split (child) — wraps in word chunks
options.[data-fx-part=tag]: Tags that light up in turn (optional) — position and tilt are the user’s transform, the part only uses scale

note: Progress is measured as ‹while stuck› (−top ÷ (height − screen)) if the attached element is taller than the screen, and from entering to leaving the screen if shorter

from.where: index.html .mk-about (”Even over ons” large About sentence — original mk-bwa: fixed progress (p−.02)/.6 wave · (p−.66)/.24 tail tag, first 7 characters · rounded to 14 steps)
